panel.alt: On the same stable work shelf, Rusk seats and supports the new compact shade on the dark side-hung lamp while Pell steadies the separate adjacent suspension collar for inspection. The shade has a single narrow lower aperture, with the framed guide pane below the lamp and the exposed collar distinctly to its side. Aren watches with empty hands from the adjoining supported landing; Sera checks the intended alignment from its guardrail. The lamp stays dark until the subsequent test.

copy.speaker: Sera
copy.text: The collar is outside the light path.
